idea-plugin.name: Raketa Route Index
idea-plugin.description: Finds the controller or handler for a URL across every app of the Raketa monorepo (Symfony app/raketa/api, Slim services in api/*, legacy entry points). Ctrl+click on a URL in a behat .feature step opens its controller. Paste a URL such as https://raketa.in/api/profiles/645701/remarks into Search Everywhere. Routes are dumped by Tools → Rebuild Raketa Route Index into the gitignored .idea/raketa-routes.json.

action.description: Dump routes of every Raketa app into .idea/raketa-routes.json
